t3_olboge.modellar: feil = armtopp - (sete_mesh + kropp) | armtopp - bord | armtopp - storleik * H
t3_olboge.silhuett_forklaring: percent of armchairs filled; row 0 = floor; 1 cm cells; canvas columns 30-129; in 'side_sete_paa_rad_60' every chair is shifted so that its sete_mesh lies on row 60 (the band 20-25 cm is then rows 80-85)

snittsilhuettar_front.forklaring: per 25-year bin 1600-1899; 75 rows (2 cm each, row 0 = floor) x 60 columns (2 cm each, canvas columns 20-139); digit = floor(10 x share of chairs covering the cell), max 9

kart_side.eining: per cent of chairs covering the pixel; 1 cm per pixel; row 0 = floor; column 0 = back

variansfelt.lesing: vinst > 0: chairs stacked in centimetres from the floor agree better than chairs scaled to a common height. The top edge of every silhouette is the catalogue H by construction.
